lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu2Co4Te8 (Lu(CoTe2)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co centers in octahedral environments with six Te neighbors, while Lu centers have eight Te neighbors and Te centers have nine neighbors (four Co, three Lu, two Te). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Te and Lu coordination polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
